restaurantName: Harbour Loft at St Michael's Mount
address: Harbour Loft, St Michael's Mount, Marazion, Cornwall,TR17 0HS
bio: Afternoon Tea at the Harbour Loft on St Michael's Mount is the perfect way to celebrate a special occasion or complete a visit to this enchanting island.  With a unique location on the beautiful island of St Michael's Mount, the Harbour Loft enjoys views of the boat-filled harbour and across the sea over to the long stretch of sandy beach on the mainland.  Head Chef, Greg Milne, has created a menu inspired by fresh Cornish produce, including ingredients grown and harvested on the island. Enjoy delicious savouries such as the cured Cornish mackerel, asparagus & prune ketchup crostini, elegant finger sandwiches, and house-baked scones with clotted cream and jam. Top this off with the stunning assortment of sweets such as walnut, tarragon & dark chocolate financier.  Choose from an extensive selection of Tregothnan tea, grown in Cornwall at the UK's first tea plantation. For an extra celebration, add a glass of Polgoon Vineyard's sparkling Seyval Blanc wine, which is produced just a stone's throw from the Mount.
pageTitle: Harbour Loft at St Michael's Mount
